categories.main_business_segments: Advancetek Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily engages in real estate development, focusing on the construction and sale or leasing of residential apartment buildings and commercial buildings. The company emphasizes building high-quality, safe residential and commercial properties, including villas and multi-unit residential buildings, with a focus on market segmentation and product differentiation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction techniques emphasizing concrete structural safety, durability, and seismic resistance, adhering strictly to national concrete design standards. It integrates innovative building materials such as nanotechnology-enhanced eco-friendly materials, energy-saving fixtures, and solar panels. The construction process is managed through professional project management and quality control, with outsourced construction to specialized contractors under a turnkey contract model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers and commercial tenants in Taiwan, targeting first-time buyers, upgraders, and overseas returnees. The company serves markets in urban and developing areas with demand for residential, commercial, and industrial real estate, focusing on regions with good transportation and living amenities. It also targets corporate clients for commercial office and industrial properties.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with key projects and sales concentrated in New Taipei City (including Xinzhuang and Tamsui districts), Taoyuan City, Yilan County, Taichung City, and Kaohsiung City. It focuses on areas with strong infrastructure development and urban renewal potential, including major metropolitan and growth corridors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Advancetek operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain. It acquires land, plans and designs projects, and outsources construction to contractors. The company then markets and sells or leases the completed properties to end customers, working closely with real estate agents and sales agencies for distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes sustainable development, integrating green building materials and energy-saving technologies to enhance product value and environmental performance. It invests in market research to align product design with customer needs and urban development trends. R&D focuses on construction methods, quality control, and post-sale service enhancement, with no significant expenditure on proprietary construction technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale and leasing of developed residential and commercial properties. The company recognizes income from completed project sales and rental income from commercial buildings. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on project-based real estate transactions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within Taiwan's construction and real estate development industry, Advancetek ranks around 19th by revenue among listed construction companies, holding approximately 2.25% market share. Competitors include larger firms such as Hsing Fu Fa, Shin Lu, and Kuan Te. The company differentiates itself through quality construction, integrated services, and affiliation with the broader Li Bao Group.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported net revenue of approximately NT$8.8 billion, a 68% increase from the previous year, and a pre-tax profit of about NT$2.95 billion, up 54%. Total assets stood at around NT$14.5 billion with equity of NT$8.5 billion, reflecting steady growth and improved profitability. The company maintains a stable capital structure with no significant liquidity issues and plans continued project development to sustain growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Advancetek emphasizes integrity, stable management, superior quality, and enthusiastic service as its core values. It differentiates its products by integrating advanced construction techniques, eco-friendly materials, and thoughtful design tailored to diverse customer needs. The company also offers comprehensive after-sales service and leverages the resources of the Li Bao Group to provide a holistic living experience, aiming to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term value.
